name: Rolled Jelly Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: heaping teaspoonful of baking powder
ingredients.originalText: a heaping teaspoonful of baking powder

instructions.text: Add two tablespoonfuls of water and a pinch of salt
Stir in the flour gradually, in which there should be a heaping teaspoonful of baking powder
Bake in long, shallow biscuit-tins, well greased
Turn out on a damp towel on a bread-board
Cover the top with jelly and roll up while warm

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the yolks until light
2. Add the sugar
3. Add two tablespoonfuls of water and a pinch of salt
4. Stir in the flour gradually, in which there should be a heaping teaspoonful of baking powder
5. Bake in long, shallow biscuit-tins, well greased
6. Turn out on a damp towel on a bread-board
7. Cover the top with jelly and roll up while warm
